public_body: Wachusett Regional School District School Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the committee entered executive session on contract talks not listed on the October 11 notice, but the chair did not reasonably anticipate that need 48 hours ahead.

allegations.summary: Alleged the committee went into executive session on a director's contract terms at the October 11 meeting without that topic on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it convened in executive session to discuss contract negotiations on October 11 even though that topic was not included on the notice because the Chair did not reasonably anticipate the need for an executive session 48 hours prior to the meeting.
